preview.markup.contentsRail.hide.comment: Tooltip and VoiceOver label of the toggle at the top of the Contents list that sits beside the document on a wide preview, while the list is open: pressing it folds the list away. The list is the table of contents of the document (translate Contents as the existing preview mode title). Verb phrase, sentence case, no final period. Not formatted and no count. Drafts pending native-speaker review.

preview.markup.contentsRail.show.comment: Tooltip and VoiceOver label of the same toggle while the Contents list beside the document is folded away: pressing it opens the list again. Contents is the table of contents of the document (use the same word as the existing preview mode title). Verb phrase, sentence case, no final period. Not formatted and no count. Drafts pending native-speaker review.

preview.markup.contentsRail.help.comment: VoiceOver hint of the toggle that folds or opens the Contents list beside the document on a wide preview. The list holds the headings of the document and follows where the reader is. One sentence ending with a period; does not repeat the button label. Not formatted. Not formatted and no count. Drafts pending native-speaker review.
